item.title: Issue 2: "Ready" has to be proven now.
item.description: The ABP just opened a 2-year fellowship path in 7 subspecialties for programs that can show readiness with EPAs. That makes trustworthy assessment data priceless, and a JGME study finds AI summaries of rotation comments catch most strengths but miss most areas for improvement. On the recruitment side, signals dominate who gets an interview, and a small PHM pilot shows how far a structured mentoring cohort can move confidence.
